place.title: Place {ref} (line tracking sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 4 pins into column f, one pin per row: VCC into {hole.vcc}, GND into {hole.gnd}, D0 into {hole.do}, A0 into {hole.ao}. The black sensor with its two lenses is at the top.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture. A0 gets no wire.

why: {ref} shines infrared light onto the surface in front of it and measures how much comes back: a light surface reflects it, a black line doesn't. Its comparator turns that into D0, and its second LED shows it.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its outputs are never more than the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s D0 output: 0 over a light surface, 1 over black (on most boards). The module drives this line itself.
